title: Jev-Orchestrated Decision Mesh: Caber Interstitial Decision Mesh (CIDM) — research thesis and reference implementation
description:
CIDM is a training-free orchestration design in which Jev, a typed decision model from TypeSafe AI, governs a five-unit network of existing frontier models. Jev chooses each bounded operation, receives every completed unit output, and decides whether to forward, repair, escalate, retrieve evidence or request a separate check. Execution is bounded by single-use capability permits, spend caps, hash-linked journals and release audits.

This archive contains the research thesis (docs/COMPLETE-THESIS.md, docs/THESIS.md), the reference implementation and its recorded live evidence. The concept and architecture were first published in this repository on 23 September 2026.
